a11y.apg: No role, and the absence is the design: it carries aria-hidden="true", so it is removed from the accessibility tree entirely. A placeholder has nothing to say — announcing a shimmering box would be noise. What tells a screen reader that something is loading is the live region around it, or Spinner, which does have a role. Not focusable, no keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Where the shape comes from. There is no size prop on purpose: a skeleton stands in for one specific piece of content, and only the page knows how big that is.

props.name: style
props.description: The usual way to give it width and height for a one-off. Every other div attribute passes through as well.
